newsitem.title: USA: First Brands sets 1 mln shr buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: First Brands sets 1 mln shr buyback plan.

text.p: First Brands Corp said Thursday that it will purchase of up to 1.0 million shares or 2.5 percent of its outstanding common stock.
The company said the repurchases would be made from time to time in the open market and in private transactions and that there would be no specific time limit.
First Brands said the repurchased shares would be held as treasury shares and used for general corporate purposes. The company has about 40 million common shares outstanding.
A 2.1 million share repurchase program announced in 1996 is almost complete with 130,000 shares still unpurchased, added the company.
